notes: The partnership model (employee minority stakes in PADS, Ring-the-Bell exit) and the start-up programme (+35 start-ups) could be read as enabling employee-entrepreneurs. NTG keeps at least 51% ownership, so these were scored as own innovation, taking the lower level when torn. The start-up programme expansion is planned for 2026. Gender-representation targets (30% by 2028; board 40% by 30 June 2026) are plans, not activities. Page 40 says the new target is 40% by 2028, while pages 41, 44 and 79 say 30%. S1-17 reports 6 discrimination/harassment incidents (six interrelated whistleblower harassment reports), all closed as unsubstantiated, plus two unsubstantiated corruption reports. Since none were substantiated or found by an outside body, no red flag is listed. Code of Conduct and data-privacy training are compliance training and were not counted.
